name: scroll-hero
summary: Scroll-driven hero, no build: GSAP 3.15.0 ScrollTrigger scrubs one timeline over four text sections, Lenis 1.3.26 smooths the scroll through GSAP's ticker, one fixed three.js canvas rendered on demand; reduced motion means no Lenis and jump cuts per section; ?progress=0..1, #progress= or window.__tw.setProgress(p) jumps to any point
use_for: marketing hero sections and scroll stories
the base for camera flights keyed to page sections
next: edit KEYS (one keyframe per section) and the section text
shoot states: node <threewright>/scripts/tw.mjs shot <dir> --eval "__tw.setProgress(0.5)" --out mid.png (sheet takes --eval too); a served page also takes ?progress=0.5 or #progress=0.5

verified.platform: Windows 11, Chrome 153 headless, NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti
verified.checks: tw check OK (gsap and lenis served from the npm cache with --cdn offline), tw check --reduced-motion OK (scrolling to section 3 jumped the timeline to 2/3 with no Lenis), tw lint clean; tw shot looked at over http at progress 0, 0.333, 0.667, 1 and #progress=0.5, and 0.45 with reduced motion (snapped to section 2): orange core with metal rings and beads sits opposite each text panel, panel text readable over the canvas, final view places the object above the centred panel
